question: Which chemical element with atomic number is 31?
solution:
The correct anwer is __**Gallium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Atomic Number** is the number of an element that is determined by the number of protons in it
 
• An atomic number of an element is **equal to the number of protons** in the nucleus of that atom of that element.
 
• It is us
